name: sprintpulse-retro
description: SprintPulse Retro - agile retrospectives for Jira Cloud, built on Atlassian Forge (Custom UI).

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --prefix static/retro-ui run typecheck
scripts.security: semgrep scan --config .semgrep.yml --severity ERROR --error --metrics off --quiet src static/retro-ui/src
scripts.security:advisory: semgrep scan --config .semgrep.yml --metrics off --quiet src static/retro-ui/src || true
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate:manifest && npm run lint:forge
scripts.ci: npm run validate:manifest && forge lint --environment development && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run lint:forge && npm run build && npm run security
scripts.deploy: npm run check && forge deploy -e development --non-interactive
